articles.summary: WOODLAND PARK, N.J., July 29, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Anterix (NASDAQ: ATEX) announced today that it will hold a conference call on Wednesday, August 12, 2026, at 9:00 a.m. ET. Anterix senior management will discuss the Company’s first quarter fiscal 2027 results.
articles.title: Anterix Sets First Quarter Fiscal 2027 Earnings Conference Call for Wednesday, August 12, at 9:00 a.m. ET
